name: Threadline
bound: Independent adult apparel labels; 20–200 styles with size/color variants. No rental or bespoke tailoring.
mission: Find an outfit, judge silhouette and fit, choose an available size.
nav: New / Clothing / Collections / Fit guide / About
home: Editorial outfit spread with two category entries
collection: Portrait 3-column desktop / 2-column mobile grid; compact size/color controls above products; preserve selected size when returning from a PDP.
card: 3:4 garment/model image; name; INR price; actual color count; available size entry. No automatic quick add for unresolved sizes.
pdp: Two-column outfit/detail gallery with a persistent desktop fit rail. Name → price → named color → size buttons → size-guide disclosure → add. Measurements and model context precede care and related outfits.
fields: garment measurements with units; fit description; model measurements only with consent; fabric; care; color labels; actual option inventory
uncertain: Whether it fits, how it hangs, and whether a color/size is available.
filters: Category, size, color, price; size facet must mean a purchasable variant, not a product tag alone.
mobile: Gallery then name/price then size/fit and CTA; 2-column catalog; optional compact CTA only after a valid size exists, with no focus occlusion.
extra: size-guide page and inline garment measurement table; returns policy
extend: productDetail layout=fit; productGrid card=apparel; existing categoryGrid for silhouettes; bounded outfit-links block, each product separately priced
deps: C structured fit content and option-aware facet query; D separately priced outfit attribution if merchant requests it; no automated size recommendation
accept: Choose M; navigate to fit guide and back; retain M. Unavailable M remains labelled and cannot submit; a stock race returns an inline server error without losing color.
density: Editorial/airy; 80px desktop section gaps, 32px mobile; 8px radius on utilities, square media; 1280px content.
image: 3:4 cards; 4:5 gallery; no face/hem crop unless merchant focal point explicitly supplied.
motion: Crossfade supplementary image only on hover/focus equivalence; no autoplay lookbook.
departure: Replace oversized brand-wordmark openings with immediately named garment categories and measurable fit support.

name: Playfield
bound: Adult purchasers of physical toys, puzzles and creative kits; no child accounts, behavioral profiling or age-targeted advertising.
mission: Choose an age-appropriate, interesting gift or activity and understand its contents.
nav: Shop by age / Interests / Toys / Creative kits / Product information
collection: Age/interest summary followed by explicit age-band groups and contents-rich cards; mobile uses age-group headings and toy fact rows; no forced quiz.
card: 1:1 full toy image; product name; merchant-stated age range; pieces/size when supplied; INR price. Badges never imply certification.
pdp: Image and contents gallery; adjacent age-range and supervision facts; purchase strip; full-width included-pieces diagram and factual material/dimension panel.
fields: merchant age recommendation; interests taxonomy; contents/piece count; dimensions; materials; exact warning text and source; care
uncertain: Suitability, physical scale, included pieces, and merchant-stated warnings.
filters: Merchant age bands, interest, product type, price; unknown age stays labelled information not supplied.
mobile: Two explicit choices age and interest; large tap targets; no bouncing decorative controls; facts before purchase.
extra: product information and safety-source page; care/replacement policy; adult contact
extend: categoryGrid layout=guided-bento; productGrid card=toy-facts; productDetail layout=contents; facts block
deps: C typed toy facts and bounded facets; D merchant policy for warning sourcing. No platform safety certification.
accept: Filter age 6–8 then art; remove one chip and retain the other. A product with missing age data never receives a fabricated age badge.
density: Friendly medium density; 64px / 28px section gaps; 16px media radius, 8px utilities; 1200px content.
image: 1:1 cards contain the whole object; 4:3 play photos; provide scale reference as actual merchant content.
motion: One user-initiated panel expansion; static decorative shapes; reduced motion removes transitions.
departure: Use play categories and practical contents facts rather than treating toys as a saturated apparel catalog.

name: Circuit
bound: Consumer accessories and small electronics sold as stocked products; exclude installation booking, financing and service subscriptions.
mission: Retrieve the right model, verify compatibility and compare a few factual specifications.
nav: Persistent search / Devices / Accessories / Compatibility guide / Support
home: Search and category rail before campaign
collection: Persistent desktop facet rail and dense 4-column spec cards; mobile compact list with filter sheet; 2–3 item compare tray only after contract delivery.
card: 1:1 contained product; manufacturer/model; 2 typed key specifications; INR price; stock label; compare checkbox only when working.
pdp: Thumbnail column and contained product diagram; model/variant selector; compatibility status tied to an explicit reference; CTA; full-width specification table below.
fields: brand/model; connector; compatible device models with reference/source; power units; dimensions; supported warranty text supplied by merchant
uncertain: Will it work with my device, what is included, and what exactly does this model support?
filters: Type, brand, connector, model compatibility and price; normalize units and treat unknown values explicitly.
mobile: Search remains reachable; list rows prioritize model and two specs; comparison becomes a labelled horizontal table with row headers and no hidden products.
extra: compatibility guide and merchant support policy; no default warranty guarantee
extend: productGrid card=specs with list/grid density; productDetail layout=technical; reusable factsTable; bounded comparison module
deps: C typed unit-aware attributes and compare query; D compatibility statement ownership; optional compare deferred until real normalized data exists
accept: Compare two USB chargers; unlike units are normalized or marked incomparable. Missing compatibility says unconfirmed; it never asserts fits all.
density: Compact functional; 48px / 24px sections; 4px radius, tabular numerals; 1360px content.
image: 1:1 contain, never crop ports; 16:9 annotated feature images with equivalent text.
motion: Immediate state feedback and subtle table updates; no rotating specification carousels.
departure: Use a search/specification hierarchy instead of a lifestyle image as the principal retrieval tool.

name: Pantry
bound: Shelf-stable packaged food and ingredients; no restaurant ordering, cold-chain promise, rapid local delivery or subscription.
mission: Identify ingredients and allergens, choose pack quantity, buy known staples efficiently.
nav: Search / Pantry shelves / Dietary information / Recipes / About
home: Compact seasonal feature and shelf shortcuts
Shop pantry staples in labelled rows
Pack-size value explanation without fake discounts
collection: Grouped shelf/list rows with package image, net quantity, price and explicit option entry; desktop can show 2 rows abreast, mobile one list.
card: Square pack image; item; net weight/volume; sale price; unit price only with valid units; dietary tags only supplied facts; one-tap add only for one available SKU.
pdp: Three zones: package/food image; ingredient/allergen information; pack-size and quantity purchase panel. Nutrition/storage/recipe information follows.
fields: ingredients; allergen statement and source; net quantity/unit; pack count; storage; nutrition text if supplied; shelf-life policy rather than invented current expiry date
uncertain: Contents, allergens, value per quantity, storage and preparation.
filters: Product shelf, supplied dietary tags, price; dietary tags are not medical advice or a guarantee against cross-contact.
mobile: Allergen summary visible before CTA; compact pack-size choices; no bottom overlay hiding warnings; quantity changes announce server result.
extra: ingredient information; storage guide; shipping policy; recipe pages
extend: productGrid layout=shelf-list card=pantry; productDetail layout=ingredients; unitPrice display primitive; richText recipe links
deps: C structured net-quantity and ingredient hydration; B base quantity controls; C server-authoritative unit-price derivation; D perishable operations excluded
accept: Choose 2 × 250g and see pack count, total net quantity and server price. Missing allergen data says not supplied; no allergen-free badge is invented.
density: Readable shelf density; 56px / 24px sections; 6px radius; 1240px content.
image: 1:1 whole package; 4:3 prepared-food context labelled serving suggestion where appropriate.
motion: Quantity confirmation and collapsible nutrition panel only; never animate a scarcity countdown.
departure: Put ingredients and pack information ahead of decorative storytelling; keep stocked pantry commerce bounded.

name: Habitat
bound: Stocked furniture and larger home objects; no interior-design service, custom manufacturing configurator or AR planner.
mission: Judge scale/material, confirm dimensions and understand actual delivery constraints.
nav: Rooms / Furniture / Materials / Measurement guide / Delivery information
home: Room index beside panoramic room story
collection: Room breadcrumb and horizontal category rail; 2 large desktop cards, 1 on mobile; dimension/finish facts beneath each object.
card: 4:3 room/object pair; name; width × depth × height with units; finish; INR price. No misleading price from an unavailable finish.
pdp: Panoramic room image above object detail; dimension diagram and finish choices adjacent to purchase; assembly/materials and actual shipping-policy link follow.
fields: width/depth/height and unit; assembled/package dimensions where supplied; finish/material; assembly text; shipping profile and policy link
uncertain: Will it fit the room and access path, what is it made of, and how is delivery handled?
filters: Room/type, maximum dimensions after normalized attributes, material, finish and price.
mobile: Single-column room-to-object gallery; dimensions as actual text/table, not only a diagram; persistent access to finish/price after long gallery without covering content.
extra: measurement guide; materials/care; assembly instructions; merchant delivery policy
extend: heroBanner layout=room-index; productGrid card=dimensions; productDetail layout=spatial; factsTable with unit formatting
deps: C typed dimensions and facts hydration; D delivery-date promise requires validated operational contract; AR and service scheduling E
accept: Switch finish and preserve measured dimensions when common; variant-specific dimensions update correctly. No pincode delivery date is shown without a live server result.
density: Spacious, measured; 88px / 32px sections; 2px media radius, 6px controls; 1320px content.
image: 4:3 cards, 16:9 rooms; keep the whole object visible; separate measured diagram with text equivalents.
motion: Manual gallery switching; no automatic parallax; material changes have an explicit selected label.
departure: Make room fit and delivery uncertainty prominent rather than treating furniture as small tableware.

name: Kindred
bound: Ready-made, stocked gifts and curated sets sold as ordinary products. No guaranteed arrival date or complex build-a-box.
mission: Find a suitable gift by occasion, recipient and budget, then check contents and packaging.
nav: Occasions / For whom / Under a budget / Ready-made sets / Gift help
home: Occasion tiles rather than a campaign hero
Editor-curated gift combinations sold as listed
collection: Occasion/recipient/budget finder rail beside a two-column curated gift gallery; mobile opens with one complete gift and smaller alternatives; suitability notes remain visible.
card: 4:3 gift/set photograph; title; included items count when known; short merchant suitability note; INR price; packaging label only if supplied.
pdp: Open-box/closed-box media pair; what is included checklist; packaging choice only if a genuine SKU; gift note only after contract validation; purchase summary.
fields: occasion/recipient tags; complete set contents; packaging description; optional typed note constraints if supported; real shipping policy
uncertain: Is it suitable, what arrives in the box, and can the merchant support my requested message?
filters: Occasion, recipient preference, budget; recipient labels describe gifts, never inferred sensitive personal traits.
mobile: Three independent discovery chips with an obvious skip-to-all; contents before CTA; gift note editable in cart only if end-to-end supported.
extra: gift help; packaging information; shipping policy; returns for gift recipients if merchant policy allows
extend: categoryGrid layout=occasion-finder; productGrid card=gift; productDetail layout=contents; optional note editor after C
deps: D repurposing Summit generic fallback requires identity/version decision; C gift-message contract and persistence; D arrival claims and configurable bundles
accept: Set Birthday and ₹1,000–₹2,000, then remove budget without losing occasion. A missing gift-message capability produces no interactive message field.
density: Curated medium; 64px / 28px sections; 10px media, 8px controls; 1200px content.
image: 4:3 complete box and contents; 1:1 packaging detail. Decorative ribbons never substitute for included-items data.
motion: Single chip/result transition and calm expansion; no forced carousel of occasions.
departure: Support suitability-led retrieval as a distinct mission; avoid personalization inputs for ordinary ready-made gifts.

name: MadeYours
bound: Initial proposal: stocked base objects with bounded text personalization only. Launch blocked until server validation and order persistence are proven.
mission: Choose a base, enter permitted text, review exactly what will be produced, and confirm constraints.
nav: Choose a base / How personalization works / Examples / Production policy / Help
home: Process-led three steps: choose, specify, review
What can and cannot be customized
collection: Base-product catalog with personalization area and supported limits on cards; no fake live customization overlay.
card: 1:1 base image; name; personalization method; maximum characters from contract; base/total price distinctions only if server-defined.
pdp: Workspace layout: base preview left, step form right; base variant → text → review. Plain text summary is authoritative; graphical preview is explicitly illustrative. Cart contains immutable validated configuration snapshot.
fields: allowed characters; normalized length/grapheme rules; safe text bounds; placement/method; production policy; server price consequences; configuration version
uncertain: What will be made, what characters fit, how price changes and whether it can be corrected before ordering.
filters: Base product, supported method, price; filter cannot advertise unsupported uploads or logo printing.
mobile: One visible step at a time with back/edit, retained inputs and review screen; errors near field and summary; no forced account or hidden auto-submit.
extra: personalization constraints; production time policy; cancellation/returns policy; help
extend: productDetail layout=configurator; typed customization schema, preview and review blocks integrated into canonical cart island; no new renderer
deps: C/D end-to-end configuration validation, order snapshot and merchant fulfillment visibility; E file uploads/proof approvals for initial release; text escaping and abuse limits mandatory
accept: Enter a disallowed character and see a precise recoverable error. Edit text in cart and revalidate price; two different configurations do not merge into one line. Retry produces one order effect.
density: Form workspace; 48px / 24px sections; 8px controls, 4px preview; 1280px content.
image: 1:1 base product, 4:3 preview stage; preserve printable placement proportion, provide the same configuration as text.
motion: Step progress and validation feedback only; preview changes after deliberate input; honor reduced motion.
departure: Make configuration constraints the primary architecture. Existing generic line properties do not justify a simulated personalization service.

name: Dewdrop
bound: Non-medical skincare, cosmetics and personal-care products; no diagnosis, clinical personalization or inferred health profile.
mission: Find a product by routine/use, inspect ingredients or shade, and understand directions.
nav: Shop by use / Routine / Ingredients / Shades / About
home: Routine sequence as independent product links
collection: Three routine-stage shelves with independent product rows under each stage; mobile stacks stage groups with use/format/shade controls and labelled swatches; no health quiz.
card: 4:5 bottle/texture; name; product type/use; net quantity; INR price; named shade count. No fabricated before/after or ratings.
pdp: Bottle and texture gallery with named shade selector; use instructions and ingredient list adjacent to purchase; factual claims sourced, patch-test text only if merchant supplies it.
fields: ingredient list; net quantity; directions; shade names/codes; routine stage; factual claim source; actual warnings
uncertain: Which format/shade suits the intended use, what it contains and how to use it.
filters: Routine stage, format, supplied ingredient attributes, shade, price; no disease-related suitability promises.
mobile: Short use summary then shade/input, ingredients and CTA; swatches have text labels and selected state beyond color.
extra: ingredient glossary with source; how-to-use; merchant returns policy
extend: productGrid card=care; productDetail layout=ingredient-routine; richText routine links; accessible option swatches
deps: C ingredient/routine attributes and hydration; B existing variants; D claims approval policy; no automatic medical recommendations
accept: Select an identically colored shade with a different name through keyboard; the name, image and actual variant update. Missing ingredients remain explicitly absent.
density: Calm readable; 72px / 28px sections; 12px media and 8px controls; 1200px content.
image: 4:5 product/texture; whole package visible; real shade sample and textual label; no simulated efficacy imagery.
motion: Manual texture/gallery transition and routine disclosure; no mandatory scrolling animation.
departure: Keep routines informational and each SKU independent; avoid treatment claims or a diagnostic questionnaire.

name: Trailmark
bound: Recreational accessories, clothing and non-safety-critical equipment. Exclude regulated/safety-critical gear fitting and activity booking.
mission: Find equipment for an activity and verify relevant size, conditions and compatibility.
home: Activity selector in a dark masthead
Three activity pathways with equipment counts
Performance facts over a restrained action image
collection: Activity breadcrumb, discipline/type sidebar and 3-column factual cards; mobile activity chips and compact equipment rows.
card: 4:3 whole equipment; name; intended activity; 2 relevant facts with units; INR price. Apparel card switches to actual sizes, not generic performance claims.
pdp: Action/context image plus technical diagram; activity-fit facts panel; named model/size; CTA; comparison/spec table and care below.
fields: activity; category-specific size data; compatibility reference; dimensions/weight; supplied use-condition text; care
uncertain: Suitability for my activity, the fit/model, and actual conditions of use.
filters: Activity, type, measured size and supplied compatibility; size schemas differ by equipment category.
mobile: Activity context stays in breadcrumb; gallery then model/size and relevant facts before CTA; no permanent full-screen action video.
extra: selection guide; size guide by category; care; merchant support policy
extend: categoryGrid layout=activity-paths; productGrid card=equipment; productDetail layout=performance; shared factsTable with category-specific groups
deps: C category-specific attributes and option facets; D safety-critical products explicitly excluded; no false testing/certification badges
accept: Switch from clothing to equipment; clothing sizes disappear and measured equipment attributes appear. An unknown compatibility field never becomes universal.
density: Purposeful medium-compact; dark masthead, light reading area; 56px / 24px sections; 4px radius; 1320px content.
image: 4:3 whole equipment; 16:9 activity story; technical detail on plain background with units.
motion: Activity category change and selected model feedback; pause/avoid autoplay action clips.
departure: Separate sporting equipment decisions from an apparel lookbook; retain readable light specification sections.

name: Marginalia
bound: Print books plus a small stationery range. Initial retrieval centered on author/genre/format; no marketplace, digital DRM or course platform.
mission: Retrieve a known title or explore a subject, check edition/format, and inspect a permitted excerpt.
nav: Prominent search / Books / Authors / Subjects / Stationery / Journal
home: Editorial pick as cover plus text excerpt
Horizontal subject shelves with visible all links
collection: Left subject/format index on desktop; list rows of narrow covers and bibliographic text; mobile cover/text rows with filter sheet.
card: 2:3 uncropped cover; title; author; format/language; INR price. Stationery uses a separate 1:1 image and paper/size facts.
pdp: Narrow cover column and bibliographic purchase summary; synopsis and permitted excerpt in reading column; edition/format selector explicit; full bibliographic table below.
fields: author; genre/subject; format; language; publisher; edition/ISBN where supplied; pages; excerpt permission; stationery paper weight/size
uncertain: Correct title/edition, language and physical format; paper and dimensions for stationery.
filters: Subject, author, format, language, price; stationery facets appear only in its collection.
mobile: Visible search and subject shortcut; cover/text rows rather than a giant hero; long titles wrap without losing author/format.
extra: author pages; excerpt rights policy; stationery guide; store information
extend: productGrid layout=bibliographic-list card=book; productDetail layout=reading; category index; sanitized excerpt block
deps: C typed bibliographic fields/search facets; D excerpt permission and content rights; no unauthorized digital reader
accept: Two editions with the same title remain distinguishable by author, language and format. Missing ISBN is omitted; long titles remain readable at 200% text zoom.
density: Text-rich but legible; 56px / 24px sections; 2px covers, 4px controls; 1240px content; 65-character reading column.
image: 2:3 cover contain; no artwork crop; 1:1 stationery objects; excerpt as text rather than inaccessible scanned image.
motion: Shelf scrolling remains optional; next/previous buttons and all-items links; no automatic page turning.
departure: Use bibliography and retrieval structure rather than a fashion grid with book-cover photography.
